message.content:
Multiple products are described, but all are liquid fertilizers in 1-liter containers. HTS 3105 covers mineral or chemical fertilizers with two or three of the fertilizing elements nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium, in packages of 10 kg or less. Aminomix has N and P. Biofran has N, P, and K. Mega has N, P, and K. Max Fulvic has only N and K, so it also fits under two fertilizing elements.

Within 3105, the candidate subheadings are:
- 3105.10: goods of this chapter in tablets or similar forms or in packages of gross weight not exceeding 10 kg.
- 3105.20: mineral or chemical fertilizers containing the three elements N, P, and K.
- 3105.51 and 3105.59: other fertilizers containing N and P.
- 3105.60: fertilizers containing P and K.

Subheading 3105.10 covers packages of 10 kg or less, which includes 1-liter containers. The statistical suffix for 3105.10.00 is 3105.10.0000, with 3105.10.00 being the general subheading for packages not exceeding 10 kg. Since the 1-liter containers fall within this limit, 3105.10.0000 is the most applicable.
